Kid's Braids Appointments Near Oakland, CA

What are kids’ braids?

Kids’ braids are braided hairstyles for kids.

How much do kids’ braids cost?

The cost of kids’ braids ranges from $40 to $200.

Price estimates are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute an offer to purchase services at the estimates stated. Please contact your StyleSeat Professional for pricing details on your selected service.

How much should you tip for your kids' braids?

Tipping 20 percent of the total cost for your kids’ braids appointment is the best rule of thumb to follow. Consider varying your tip based on the cleanliness of the braider’s working area, their friendliness, and your satisfaction with the results.
